tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i phyi rol tshogs bsag gi cho ga maṇ+ḍal la brten te sgrub cing mchod pa bzhugs so// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i phyi rol tshogs bsag gi cho ga maṇ+ḍal la brten te sgrub cing mchod par 'dod pas/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i gnas dben par phyag dar dang skyang nul byas la/ der khru gang yan chad ji ltar 'tshams pa'i tshad kyis zlum por byas pa la ba'i rnam pa lnga'am dri bzang gis byugs te/ gnas srung gi me tog bzhag go /de'i mthar byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar du bsang gtor dang mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas bsham/ spyi mchod de'i nang du bdug spos/ mar me/ zhal zas gsum shar nub gnyis su tshan pa drug re dang / lho byang gnyis su tshan pa bzhi re ste nyi shu bsham/ de yang nub kyi gnyis shar gyi snam bu'i reg rdo rje ma dang chos dbyings rdo rje ma gnyis kyi yin la/ shar gyi gnyis gtso bo yab yum dang / rigs bdag gnyis kyi yin cing / lhag ma phyogs re rer bzhi bzhir gnas pa ni nub kyi bzhi shar dang / shar lho'i 'khor gyi lha bzhi'i yin pa sogs so/ /de'i shar phyogs su ci 'byor pa'i yo byad kyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma rgyal mtshan nam/ ba dan gyis spras pa lnga bsham/ gzhan yang bla re dang / ba dan dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / gos zung dang / rol mo'i yo byad la sogs pa rnams bshams shing / rang gi mdun du nang mchod dang / rdo rje dril bu yang bsham mo/ /de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas nas brtsams te/ sgrub pa'i thabs las byung ba'i rim pas/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bdag bskyed rgyas pa bsgom te/ rang gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis/

maṇ+ḍal dbus kyi gnas srung gi me tog bsal te/ dri'i thig le gru bzhi bya ste/ me tog cung zad cig bzhag de nas maṇ+ḍal bgegs mthar byed kyis bsang / shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las am̐ dmar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa nag po kha gyes pa/ lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer phyogs kun du 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bsal la/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer de nyid las rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / drwa ba dpangs dpag tshad brgya stong du yod pa/ bdud thams cad kyis bgrod par mi nus pa phyogs thams cad khyab pa/ phyi rol na dus mtha'i me'i phung po 'bar ba lta bus bskor ba dang / rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa'i dkyil 'khor sa 'og gi mthar thug par bsams la/ chos 'byung nas bzung ste/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa sgrub thabs ltar bsgom mo/ /de nas dbus su slar yang me tog spungs te/ oṃ āḥmāṃ hūm̐ zhes pa gtso bo'i sngags lan gsum dang / 'khor gyi lha so so'i gnas su dri'i thig le dang / me tog gi tshom bu re bya ste/ so so'i sngags lan gsum gsum bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nas brtsams te/ bgegs mthar byed kyi bar skad cig gis bskyed nas sgrub pa'i thabs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug dang / dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'i bar rnams bya'o/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kha'i sa bon mam̐ yig las 'od zer spros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug ste zhal nas zhugs pa sogs lha mo bcu sgrub thabs ltar mngal du bskyed pa oṃ badz+ra sa pha ra ṇa kham̐ zhes pas de rnams rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros dpag tu med par gyur nas mdun bskyed kyi mtha' skor du 'khod nas dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par bsam ste/

mchod rdzas rnams bgegs mthar byed kyis bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs gsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ngo bo bzang shing rgya che ba/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod la/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ lha yi bsang gtor dam pa 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor mchod par bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /mgon pos mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ mam̐ mañju badz+ra oṃ āḥmam̐ hūm̐/ zhes pas gtso bo yab yum dang / oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka oṃ āḥmam̐ hūm̐/ zhes pas rigs bdag dang / de bzhin du oṃ bum̐ dzi na dzika dang / oṃ ām̐ rat+na ḍhṛka oṃ dz+rīṃ ā ཿro lika oṃ kham̐ pra dz+nyā ḍhṛka oṃ lam̐ mo hā ra tī/ oṃ mam̐ dwe ṣa ra tī/ oṃ pām̐ ra ga ra tī/ oṃ tām̐ badz+ra ra tī/ oṃ dza rū pa badz+rī/ oṃ hūm̐ shab+da badz+rī/ oṃ bam̐ gan+dhe badz+rī/ oṃ hoḥr sa badz+rī/ oṃ kham̐ par+ṣe badz+rī/ oṃ ram̐ dharma dhā tu badz+rī/ oṃ hūm̐ ya mān+ta krita/ oṃ hūm̐ pradz+nyān+ta krita/ oṃ hūm̐ pad+mān+ta krita/ oṃ hūm̐ bighān+ta krita/ oṃ āḥmam̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa re re bzhin sbyar bas 'khor gyi lha rnams la dbul lo/ /de bzhin du mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil gnyis kyang tshigs bcad kyi 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs sngags rnams 'dra'o/

/chu skyes de bzhin thang las skyes/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni khyod kyis bzhes/ /oṃ mam̐ mañju badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ hūm̐ bighān ta krita puṣ+paṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung / /de bzhin bdug spos mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes/ /lha so so'i sngags la dhū pam̐ pra tīts+tsha ye btags pas bdug spos dbul/ zhun mar 'bru mar mar me 'di/ /lha rdzas 'bar bas mun pa 'joms/ /mi shes thams cad zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid dad pas dbul bar bgyi/ /lha so so'i sngags la dī pam̐ pra tīts+tsha sbyar bas mar me dbul/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yis/ /dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes/ /lha so so'i sngags la gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha sbyar bas dri mchog dbul/ bza' dang bca' bar yang dag ldan/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan zhing / /thams cad sbyar ba'i zhal zas 'di/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /lha so so'i sngags la nai bid+yā btags pas zhal zas dbul/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs/ /dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di/ /mchog tu dga' bas bdag 'bul gyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /lha so so'i sngags la shāb+da pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā sbyar ba dang / badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta'i sngags brjod pas rol mo ci 'byor par dbul lo/ /de nas gzugs sogs thabs kyi ngo bor byas pa'i mchod pa rgyud kyi dngos bstan/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas zhes sogs rje bla mas mdzad pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga mchod sprin rgya mtsho las 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /gzugs sogs shes rab kyi ngo bor byas pa'i mchod pa ni/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/

/'jo sgeg sgyu 'phrul rol pas mtha' yas zhing bkang nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba dpe med gzugs kyi sprin gyis mchod/ /kun 'dzin rnams sbyong ma chags rab dga'i sa bsgrub shog /oṃ āḥru pa badz+rī hūm̐/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /yan lag 'khril ldan dbyangs kyis mtha' yas zhing bkang nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba dpe med sgra yis sprin gyis mchod/ /'chal tshul rnams sbyong khrims dag dri med sa sgrub shog /oṃ āḥshāb+da badz+rī hūm̐/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /dri zhim spos ngad ldan pas mtha' yas zhing bkang nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba dpe med dri zhim sprin gyis mchod/ /khro ba rnam sbyong bzod dag 'od byed sa bsgrub shog /oṃ āḥgan+dhe badz+rī hūm̐/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /ro mchog brgya ldan mtha' yas bcud kyis zhing bkang nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba dpe med ro mchog sprin gyis mchod/ /le lo rnam sbyong brtson dag 'od 'phro'i sa bsgrub shog /oṃ āḥr sa badz+rī hūm̐/ bud med mtshanྎ /'jam zhing bde skyed reg byas mtha' yas zhing bkang nas/ ma lus rgyal ba dpe med reg mchog sprin gyis mchod/ /g.yeng ba rnams sbyong rtse gcig sbyang dka'i sa bsgrub shog /oṃ āḥpar+ṣe badz+rī hūm̐/ bud medྎ /spros med rgya chen chos kyi mtha' yas zhing bkang nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba dpe med chos kyi sprin gyis mchod/ /mi shes rnam sbyong shes rab mngon gyur sa bsgrub shog /oṃ āḥdharma dhā tu badz+rī hūm̐/ /zhes pas mchod/ de nas thun mong gi mchod pa dang / khyad par gyi mchod pa dang / lus ngag yid gsum gyis mchod pa rnams ni mchod sprin rgya mtsho bzhin bya'o/ /nang gi mchod pa la bsdu na/ bla ma'i mtshan gyi skabs su 'di'i bla ma brgyud pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi sngags kyi skabs su 'di'i sngags rnams brjod nas/

rigs drug gi sems can tshim pa'i bar pha rgyud spyi dang mthun pa'i nang mchod 'bul ba nyid kyis chog la/ rgyas par spro na nang gi mchod pa lnga char yang mchod sprin rgya mtsho ltar bya'o/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa ni rang gi snying kha nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dpag tu med pa spros nas mdun gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phul bas/ rgyal ba rnams rig ma'i 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod cing / mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar bsams la/ mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma thugs rje'i spyan/ /brtan mdzad dbyings kyi 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun/ /zhi mdzad thabs mkhas ring song sa sgrub ma/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma byams pa'i bdag /brlan mdzad dbyings kyi 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun/ /srung mdzad smon lam mi g.yo'i sa sgrub ma/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'iྎ /mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma dga' dkar mo/ /smin mdzad dbyings kyi 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun/ /rgyas mdzad mi brdzi legs pa'i sa sgrub ma/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'iྎ /mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma btang snyoms sgrol/ /g.yo mdzad dbyings kyi 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun/ /dbang mdzad ye shes chos sprin sa sgrub ma/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'iྎ /mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma ye shes dbyings/ /go 'byed dbyings kyi 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun/ /mchog mdzad chos sku kun tu 'od sgrub ma/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /re re'i mjug tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3ham̐/ zhes brjod pas mchod do/ /de nas yid las byung ba'i mchod pa gsum dang / bla na med pa'i mchod pa gsum yang mchod sprin rgya mtsho bzhin byas nas/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ni rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de nyid lnga pa dang /

gang gi dngos kun gdod nas gsal ba sogs dang / rje bla mas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i bstod pa rnams kyis mchod do/ /de nas dam tshig gzung ba ni lugs 'di'i rgyun bshags lan gsum dang / rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum bya ste/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa yang dkyil 'khor 'di'i sngags kyi bzlas pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas mdun du bshams pa'i gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ gtor ma dang po gtor chog ltar 'das pa'i lha la dbul/ gnyis pa gur gyi mgon po la dbul/ gsum pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi bka' srung mgon po gdong bzhi pa la dbul/ bzhi pa gur gyi mgon po'i las mgon rnams la dbul/ lnga pa gtor chog ltar phyogs skyong rnams la dbul/ de nas dpa' bo'i ston mo la longs spyod rgyu yod na mchod cing byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje'i glu dang / bkra shis brjod pa'i bar tshul bzhin du bya'o/ /rjes kyi cho ga ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos te bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī gu h+ya sa mā dza maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa kun la sbyar ba'i chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo'i bar dang / rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ lha so so'i sa bon gyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas bdud rtsi dbul/ sngar ltar dngos grub blangs la yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod cing / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus la skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab ste/ sgrub pa'i thabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ sman pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam dang / rje bla mas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa'i nang gi rgyun bshags kyi mjug gi smon lam rnams btab la chos 'chad pa sogs chos mthun gyi bya ba la 'jug par bya'o/

/dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs la/ /tshul bzhin mchod pa'i cho ga 'di phul bas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la phan bde'i char phab nas/ /shes rab snang ba phyogs bcur 'bar gyur cig /'di yang shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges sbyar ba'o// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 go bo rab 'byams pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i phyi rol tshogs bsag gi cho ga maṇ+ḍal la brten te sgrub cing mchod pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
